title: Lively Spicy Mediterranean Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful plant-based stew featuring red pepper flakes and kombu-cold-extract, perfect for a chilly evening. This winey and chewy dish is inspired by the bold flavors of the Mediterranean.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the red pepper flakes and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the kombu-cold-extract, canned diced tomatoes, vegetable broth, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add the rinsed and drained red lentils to the pot and continue to simmer for an additional 20 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
